summary.note: Oracle uses observed single-run elapsed time and omits selection cost. A censored run is not assigned an invented completion time; infeasible methods are excluded from feasible per-case winners.

post_run_all_scope_analysis.interpretation: Only observed single-repeat timing spread. The per-case oracle omits selection/portfolio overhead, and short setup timings vary visibly even for identical synthetic feature matrices/core sizes. No new threshold selected and no adaptive success claim.
